title: Similar: Dubbed Visual Cleanup
goal: Prepare a localization-ready video master by hiding a burned-in source-language subtitle strip, reframing the picture to preserve a clean lower-third area, and compositing a provided channel watermark while keeping the original program audio intact.
skillBenefitRationale: The essential work is a timed FFmpeg filter graph that combines blur or crop-based cleanup, scaling, and overlay placement; no other shipped skill is needed to achieve the required result.
